_readme: TODO(ariel): authored core (representation). The harness refuses to run --attributes while any blank remains.
For every field: write the one-sentence 'definition' the model reads (this is the label's meaning; §83's lesson),
and for every allowed value give the number in [0,1] that score.js uses for it (1 = most desirable for the editor).
Rename, add or delete values and fields freely; field names must match the keys in weights.json.
'unknown' is always allowed and never listed. Bumping prompt_version invalidates the attribute cache.
Fields with role hard_rule:* are facts only; score.js applies the editor's 2026-07-09 rules (alcohol -> Couples, kids -> Families).
section_appeal routes a series to a section ONLY when no R7 scores are supplied (demo fallback).
